rule: Thumbnail size resolution must respect the sizeRounding argument and otherwise use the default (UP); code must not hard-code NEAREST or its own rounding.
naive: Resolver ignores the sizeRounding argument and hard-codes ThumbnailSizeRounding.NEAREST.
variant_note: In saleor/graphql/app/types.py the seed passes the size_rounding argument to get_thumbnail_size in AppManifestBrandLogo.resolve_default and gives get_logo_cache_size a size_rounding parameter (default None, so UP) instead of hard-coded NEAREST. AppBrandLogo.resolve_default keeps the hard-coded NEAREST of the source seed, because Study C did not mark it.
